methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Clippership is a seed-stage company in ocean and maritime technology founded by Nico Cymbalist, Luca Cymbalist, and Kai Matsuka. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of three private peers operating in adjacent maritime subsectors: Standard Subsea, NetworkOcean, and Albacore. No public companies provide direct comparability in this nascent segment.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method given data constraints. The stage-progression approach uses the $5M total capital raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression in deep-tech sectors. This yields a point estimate of $12M. The triangulation range spans $11M (low) to $14M (high), with $12M as the median.

The analysis supports a valuation in the $11M–$14M range, with $12M as the central case. Key uncertainties include the limited comp set (three private peers with likely heterogeneous business models and stage positioning), absence of public market anchors, and opacity around capital deployment efficiency and product-market validation metrics for Clippership specifically. Investors should stress-test this range against burn rate, runway, and near-term milestones before final investment decision.
